title: Toms3Announcer
description: Console announcer used in Toms3 Anarchy
body:
![Toms3Announcer function](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a778399a11cff2a91fd536e5a1c6b6abd70468f.png)
Console announcer plugin used in Toms3. Comes with MiniMessage support and doesn't require any dependencies.

Use: /announce [message] [times the message will be repeated (can be empty)]

**CONSOLE ONLY.** OPs cannot use the command.
